flag.source_dir: Uvimba weefayile ongumthombo we-Mantl wezicwangciso zeziseko ezingundoqo
root.long:
I-Mantl ithatha inkcazo yeqonga ecacisiweyo ize iyihlanganise ibe
ziziseko ezingundoqo, i-topology ye-GitOps, kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo yokuthotyelwa.
root.short: I-Mantl ngumhlanganisi weqonga oqhutywa yinkcazo kunye nexesha lokusebenza
